en.plugins.stickercmd.desc: Bind a command to a sticker (reply to the sticker)
en.plugins.stickercmd.reply_sticker:
❌ Reply to a sticker with `{0}setcmd <command>`

*Examples:*
• `{0}setcmd vv` - reveal a view-once message
• `{0}setcmd ping` - run ping
• `{0}setcmd menu` - show the menu
en.plugins.stickercmd.unknown_command:
❌ Unknown command: `{0}`

_Use `{1}menu` to see the available commands_
